title: Warm Smoky Kenyan Corn Skewers
description: Earthy and snappy, these festive Kenyan corn skewers are perfect for any occasion, featuring a unique blend of instant yeast and smoky flavors, all while being low-calorie-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium heat, about 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together corn kernels, instant yeast, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Thread about 1/4 cup of the corn mixture onto each skewer, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with lemon juice and olive oil, making sure they are well coated.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the corn is lightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the grill and serve warm.
Garnish with fresh herbs, such as parsley or cilantro, if desired.
